newsitem.title: ITALY: Albanian wrecks two Italian police cars in chase.
newsitem.headline: Albanian wrecks two Italian police cars in chase.

text.p: An Albanian driving a stolen vehicle sent Italian police on a high-speed chase on Thursday, destroying two of their cars before he was finally stopped after 110 km (70 miles), police said.
The early-morning chase began after they saw an Audi speeding down a motorway outside the northern city of Verona.
It ended about an hour later with the arrest of a 23-year-old illegal immigrant -- after he had rammed through two motorway blockades and injured three police officers.
